results.title: Left Right Christmas Game Printable: 6 Pass the Gift Stories for Family, Office and Kids, Big-Type Host Cards and TV Screen Version
results.description:
A left right Christmas game for your family Christmas party, office party or classroom: 6 original pass-the-gift stories, each with its own big-type host card AND a TV screen version, plus a story you can fill with your own guests' names. A fun game for a large group, with no prep: read, pass, laugh, keep the gift.

How it works: everyone holds a wrapped gift. The host reads a story out loud. Every time you hear LEFT, pass your gift left; every time you hear RIGHT, pass it right. Whoever holds a gift when the story ends keeps it. Stories 1 to 5 run about 300 to 335 words with 26 to 28 passes each (about 3 to 4 minutes read aloud); story 6 is a quick 2-minute warm-up.

THE 6 STORIES (all original, no movie or song characters)
1. The Family Christmas Countdown: family (28 passes, about 3 min)
2. The Office Party Memo: office and adults (27 passes, about 3 min)
3. The Snowman's Missing Mitten: kids and classrooms (27 passes, about 3 min)
4. The Road to Bethlehem: church, family and Sunday school (26 passes, about 3 min)
5. The Gift Nobody Wanted: white elephant and gift swaps (26 passes, about 4 min)
6. The Last-Minute Shopper: quick game, any group (19 passes, about 2 min)
Story 5 adds a white elephant STEAL twist: on STEAL, swap gifts with the player across from you.

3 WAYS TO PLAY
- Paper: print the big-type host cards (16.75 to 18.5 pt type, easy to read in a dim room)
- TV: open the PDF on a laptop or tablet connected to your TV; 6 widescreen story slides so everyone reads along
- Type-in names: type 6 guests' names into the family story in the free Adobe Acrobat Reader, then print or show it

WHAT'S INCLUDED (21 pages + a thank-you page)
- Page 1: Cover with the story list
- Page 2: How to Play, with the rules, 3 twists and host tips
- Page 3: Host Guide: which story suits which crowd, time and number of passes
- Pages 4 to 14: 6 big-type host cards (stories 1 to 5 on two pages each, story 6 on one)
- Page 15: Type-in names story (6 fill-in boxes, or print blank and write names in)
- Pages 16 to 21: TV screen version, one 16:9 slide per story

HOW TO GET IT
This is a digital PDF download. Nothing will be shipped. After purchase, download the PDF from your Etsy account (You > Purchases) or from the email Etsy sends. The printable pages are US Letter; they print on A4 with "Fit to page". Prints in color, or in black and white on any home printer.

For personal use at your own events. Please do not resell or share the file.

results.title: Christmas Trivia Game Printable: 200 Questions in 10 Rounds for Family, Office and Game Night, Answer Keys and Team Score Sheets
results.description:
200 Christmas trivia questions for your family Christmas party, office party or holiday game night: 10 themed rounds of 20, with answer keys, a host script and team sheets, so up to 10 teams of 2 to 6 can play with no prep. Round 9 is an easy Kids' Round so younger players can join in.

Every question is original and fact-checked. There are no movie, song or TV rounds, so it works for church groups, classrooms, offices and mixed ages alike.

THE 10 ROUNDS
1. Christmas Traditions (20)
2. Christmas Around the World (20)
3. Festive Food and Drink (20)
4. Christmas History (20)
5. The Nativity Story (20)
6. Winter and Nature (20)
7. Christmas Words and Names (20)
8. True or False (20)
9. Kids' Round (20)
10. Christmas Numbers (20)

WHAT'S INCLUDED (16 pages + a thank-you page)
- Page 1: Cover with the round list
- Page 2: How to Play, with set-up, scoring, a Joker rule and a host script to read out
- Pages 3 to 12: the 10 rounds, 20 questions each (200 in all)
- Pages 13 and 14: answer keys for all 200 questions
- Page 15: Team Answer Sheet (print one per team for each round)
- Page 16: Team Score Sheet for up to 10 teams, plus 3 closest-number tie-breakers

HOW IT PLAYS
Split into teams of 2 to 6. The host reads each question twice, teams write their answers, then swap sheets and mark them while the host reads the key. One point per answer, 20 per round. Each round takes about 15 minutes with marking, so play all 10 for a full night or any 4 in about an hour.

HOW TO GET IT
This is a digital PDF download. Nothing will be shipped. After purchase, download the PDF from your Etsy account (You > Purchases) or from the email Etsy sends. Print at home or at a print shop on US Letter paper; it also prints on A4 with "Fit to page". Print as many answer and score sheets as you need for your own party.

For personal use only. Please do not resell or share the file.
